step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture handles high-volume ticketing spikes. Web traffic from external users enters via Elastic Load Balancing (ELB), distributing load across a UI layer composed of EC2 On-Demand and EC2 Spot instances. These UI instances interact with DynamoDB to read/write request state. Backend API layer EC2 instances (On-Demand and Spot) process transactions from DynamoDB and write updated results back to DynamoDB.

graph.name: TXCraft Architecture
graph.notes: Ticketing architecture handling massive concurrency using ELB, EC2 (UI and API tiers), and DynamoDB.
